scope: Dependency-free timestamped encoder input prerequisite, not a production exporter switch.

interfaces.planExportFrames(duration): Frozen frameCount/frame(index): source time in seconds; timestamp/duration in integer microseconds. 30Hz; rounded final endpoint; no duplicate terminal frame.
interfaces.prepareExportPcm(asset, plan, options): Admitted original WAV and bound soundtrack plan; frozen frameCount/blockCount/block(index). 48kHz planar Float32; at most960frames per call; original channel count. Timestamp in microseconds. Cancellation and absolute ten-second byte-read deadline.

numericalContract: Video endpoint is nearest microsecond; positive durations below one microsecond refuse.
PCM covers ceil(sequenceDuration*48000) sample frames. Final partial sample adds less than one sample interval of represented coverage.
PCM16 normalization divides by32768; source sample frames are linearly interpolated at their original rate, multiplied by authored gain, and quantized only by Float32 storage.
Source In is inclusive, Out exclusive. Interpolation clamps at the last included source sample; excluded original neighbors cannot leak.
Sequence-time placement preserves fractional source phase. Leading/trailing silence and zero-gain/nonoverlapping soundtracks cover the complete timeline.

push.failedCase: real six-second sequence WebM contains both immutable sources and repeats the original source clock

pr.failedCase: actual six-second trimmed WebM preserves original source phases and repeated excerpts

limits: No WebCodecs or muxer is called by this module; the production MediaRecorder path is unchanged by this prerequisite.
Linear resampling is an explicit conversion, not a native resampler equivalence or quality claim.
Decoded frame gaps remain a reproduced unfinished defect. These unit inputs do not establish native output acceptance.
Maintained locally served muxer, native capability checks/backpressure/cancellation, production integration and stalled/native full-minute decoding remain required before closing #124.
